findings.detail: Framing/scope statement is operationally qualified in rendered prose and does not assert a measured comparative result.
Design statement is explicitly framed as what this study does; rendered prose does not overclaim beyond ranking, removal, and retraining.
Both point estimates and the full-fine-tuning, overlap, and no-LoRA qualifications match the frozen facts.
Rendered prose restricts the claim to displayed methods/cells and explicitly distinguishes interval overlap from a pairwise test; the rendered overlap asset is aligned.
The two point estimates, counterproductive direction, interval exclusion of zero, and AF interpretation match the frozen facts.
The +0.52 and +0.62 estimates and zero-excluding intervals match the frozen facts; cell-specific and non-general qualifications are preserved.
The claim is restricted to displayed cells, uses interval overlap rather than pairwise inference, and preserves the narrow-budget qualification.
The two estimates and all key scope qualifications match the frozen facts, including two epochs, matched control, no paired contrast, and confounding of length and density.
The -0.58 and +0.34 values, opposite zero-excluding directions, and seed-contradiction qualification match the frozen facts.
This is a declared analytical criterion and is explicitly distinguished from a pairwise test.
Scope/design statement correctly distinguishes netted belief contrasts, held-out absorption specialization, lack of causal mediation, and diagnostic raw checkpoints.
Reporting/design policy statement; no unsupported empirical assertion.
Scope statement is consistently qualified: one topic, Qwen3 family, gradient-based methods, declared seed-paired families, and separately labeled other readings.
Explicitly identifies the random-removal arm as unrun and states the design required to exclude that alternative; no empirical result is asserted.
Rendered prose marks the trajectory formulation comparison as outside the evaluation and speculative; 'could score differently' is appropriately modal.
Rendered prose marks the denominator explanation as plausible/possible, untested, and non-causal; it does not present it as established.
Rendered prose says the seed disagreement is compatible with noise and explicitly states noise was not identified or tested from two draws.
Rendered prose correctly states that length and premise density are confounded and cannot be separated in this comparison.
